The same technique is used when breastfeeding and requires oral muscle strength. The flat symmetrical nipple is designed to promote a tongue placement and sucking technique where the tongue is flat and presses the pacifier flat against the palate for easy tongue placement and suction. This sucking technique does not require as much oral muscle strength as e.g., the round pacifier nipple. The anatomical nipple is designed as the perfect mix of the round and symmetrical nipple. description: Béaba Babycook 4-in-1 Food Maker - Grey White The Babycook® Neo is the new generation food maker from Béaba. Made with respect for the environment and the nutritional quality of food, it?s an eco-designed product using 48% less carbon dioxide and 50% less water and energy consumption than the Babycook® Solo model. It also features a high quality double level stainless steel blade for uniform mixing, including smooth, mixed, lumps and chunks. The stainless steel tank with a wide opening allows good access and easy filling with the integrated measuring levels. Soft steam modulation cooking preserves the nutritional quality of food, collecting the right amount of cooking juices and limiting water consumption. Made in France. Béaba 4 Piece Silicone Meal Set - Pink This Béaba silicone meal set includes of a plate and a bowl, baby cup and second stage spoon for baby to feed themselves. Including everything you and your baby need for weaning, the plate and bowl both have a suction pad to hold them in place. The suction pad has an easy release tab, so you can take it off quickly and easily, whilst the design and shape of the plate, bowl and spoon have been developed to help your little one scoop up food. The second stage spoon has a handle that's been adapted to a child's hand, with an integrated support to avoid the spoon touching the table to help cut down on dinnertime mess. description: Indigo is the spacious, foldable bath that’s got you covered from day one until your child is 4 years old, keeping them safe and comfy with its unique built-in digital thermometer. The Indigo bath makes bathtimes easier for your little one up to the age of 4. Let your baby enjoy every splash, while our soft anti-slip pad and HighSense thermometer keep them comfy and safe. Once bathtime’s done, Indigo folds flat for quick and compact storage. For the ultimate in baby bath comfort from day one, Indigo includes the one-of-a-kind HighSense thermometer, positioned at the bottom of the tub for the most accurate temperature reading. This exclusive feature, found only in Indigo and Indigo Plus, guarantees a perfectly warm bath (35 – 38°C). And speaking of the bottom — it's larger than most baths on the market, giving your child more room to splash, stretch, and enjoy. Bathing your baby is simple with Indigo. It sets up in seconds — on the floor or at a comfortable standing height with the Indigo Stand (sold separately). After bathtime, the wide plughole drains water quickly. Then just hang it up to dry with the built-in hook and fold it flat for easy storage. From first baths to toddler splashes, Indigo grows with your child. Its ergonomic design lets you comfortably support your baby from day one. As your little one grows, there’s still plenty of space for splashing and playing — right up to 4 years old. With soft, tonal colours and a premium finish, Indigo blends seamlessly into modern bathrooms. Its sleek silhouette is designed not just for beauty but for ease — featuring soft materials and a built-in anti-slip pad that adds safety without compromising on style. Product Features: Cleverly built into the base of the bath, the HighSense thermometer gives accurate readings from the warmest part of the water. A green light lets you know when the temperature is just right. The roomy design and built-in cushioned anti-slip pad keep your baby — and later, your toddler up to 4 years old — comfy and secure through all those bathtime splashes. Big on comfort, small on space! Indigo pops open in seconds and folds flat when you’re done. While the built-in hook lets you hang it up to dry out of the way. Elevate bathtime to your level with the Indigo Stand (sold separately) - because comfort matters for parents too! Getting Indigo set up and ready to use is quick and easy thanks to its retractable legs and foldable design. Indigo features smooth materials that make it easy to wipe clean. The large plughole lets you drain the water out of Indigo quickly when bathtime’s over. Indigo stays stable when set up on the floor thanks to the anti-slip pads under each of its legs. The colour indicator lets you know if the temperature is safe and comfortable for your baby. Blue means cold, red mean hot, and green means it’s just right (35 - 38°C). With tonal colours as well as premium detailing and finishing, Indigo has a design perfectly suited to modern bathrooms.
